proc.source: GOB 253 schedules a 0.01 s term marker with 30% chance and value 4. tempmods.py ApplyStunWithTimer attaches a four-second stun and an independent four-second immunity on an unprotected target.
proc.runtime: AbilityCatalog.Controls and TempMods preserve the marker, then TimedEffects.RunDue and AbilityConditionalControls.Term process the chance, immunity and state. Wounding Shot keeps its existing DOT.
proc.test: ConditionalControlTests.RifleTermStunsRollOnceAndHonorIndependentImmunity asserts the threshold hit and miss, no stun before term, existing immunity refusal, correct expiry and preservation of Wounding Shot DOT. WoundingShotKeepsItsCapturedDotAndRunsThreeRoundedUpdates checks its separate neutral DOT.

script.runtime: AbilityCatalog.Controls and TempMods preserve the marker, then TimedEffects.RunDue and AbilityConditionalControls.Term process the chance, immunity and state. Wounding Shot keeps its existing DOT.

periodic.source: GOB 253 stores a 10 s NeutralDOT at 2.5 s cadence. The retained runtime capture provides total 14 versus the GOB total 7.
periodic.runtime: TempMods.TryGet retains the capture amount and TimedEffects.RunDue executes three rounded updates, with no tick at expiry.
periodic.test: ConditionalControlTests.WoundingShotKeepsItsCapturedDotAndRunsThreeRoundedUpdates verifies initial delay, interval, three four-point ticks and expiry. The retail base-to-capture value difference stays open.

script.source: GOB 254 attaches EnableRootWithChance at 50% break chance with an eight-second root.
script.runtime: AbilityCatalog.Controls describes the root callback and TimedEffects.Holder.HealthChanged protects the initial damage event, then applies the break threshold.
script.test: ConditionalControlTests.ImmobilizingShotProtectsTheLandingHitThenUsesItsFiftyPercentBreak exercises protected damage, a retained root and a breaking roll. combat-rifle-opener-immobilizing covers the ordinary cast request and out-of-combat restriction.

proc.source: GOB 255 admits a 50% Powerless proc lasting four seconds on landing.
proc.runtime: TempMods and TimedEffects.Apply gate the control by the stored probability. CombatSpecials.IsRifleOpener confines the cast to out of combat.
proc.test: ConditionalControlTests.GunControlsRespectTheirStoredProbabilityAtLanding and combat-rifle-opener-disabling verify hit/miss and expiry as well as acceptance/refusal in the ordinary rifle path.

proc.source: GOB 493 uses a 30% Enrage proc for 10 seconds. PR324 stock Direct Fire admitted the selected and interior cone targets.
